function Write-GhostLog {
    param([string]$Message, [string]$Level = "INFO")
    $timestamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"
    $color = switch ($Level) {
        "INFO"    { "Cyan" }
        "SUCCESS" { "Green" }
        "WARNING" { "Yellow" }
        "ERROR"   { "Red" }
        default   { "White" }
    }
    Write-Host "[$timestamp] [$Level] $Message" -ForegroundColor $color
}

function Test-AdminPrivileges {
    $identity = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()
    $principal = New-Object Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal($identity)
    return $principal.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)
}

function New-DirectoryStructure {
    param([string]$BaseDir)
    
    $directories = @(
        "$BaseDir",
        "$BaseDir\boot",
        "$BaseDir\boot\isolinux",
        "$BaseDir\ghost",
        "$BaseDir\ghost\scripts",

        if (-not (Test-Path $dir)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null
            Write-GhostLog "Created directory: $dir"
        }
    }
}

function Get-WebFile {
    param(
        [string]$Url,
        [string]$Destination
    )
    
    if (Test-Path $Destination) {
        Write-GhostLog "File already exists: $Destination" -Level "WARNING"
        return $true
    }
    
    try {
        Write-GhostLog "Downloading: $Url"
        $webClient = New-Object System.Net.WebClient
        $webClient.DownloadFile($Url, $Destination)
        Write-GhostLog "Downloaded: $Destination" -Level "SUCCESS"
        return $true
    }
    catch {
        Write-GhostLog "Failed to download: $Url - $_" -Level "ERROR"
        return $false
    }
}

    echo -e "${BLUE}[*] Mounting $partition to $MOUNT_DIR...${NC}"
    
    FSTYPE=$(lsblk -no FSTYPE "$partition" 2>/dev/null)
    
    MOUNT_OPTS=""
    if [ "$readonly" = "true" ]; then
        MOUNT_OPTS="-o ro"
    fi
    
    case "$FSTYPE" in
        ntfs|ntfs-3g)
            if [ "$readonly" = "true" ]; then
                ntfs-3g -o ro "$partition" "$MOUNT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || mount -t ntfs-3g -o ro "$partition" "$MOUNT_DIR"
            else
                ntfs-3g "$partition" "$MOUNT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || mount -t ntfs-3g "$partition" "$MOUNT_DIR"
            fi
            ;;
        *)
            mount $MOUNT_OPTS "$partition" "$MOUNT_DIR"
            ;;
    esac
    
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}[+] Successfully mounted $partition${NC}"
        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${RED}[!] Failed to mount $partition${NC}"
        return 1
    fi
}

run_clamav_scan() {

    if ! command -v clamscan >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo -e "${YELLOW}[!] ClamAV not available, skipping...${NC}"
        return 1
    fi
    
    # Update definitions if online
    if ping -c 1 google.com >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "[*] Updating ClamAV definitions..."
        freshclam --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
    
    CLAM_LOG="$LOG_DIR/clamav_scan.log"
    echo "[*] Scanning $MOUNT_DIR (this may take a while)..."
    
    clamscan -r --infected --log="$CLAM_LOG" \
        --exclude-dir="^/sys" \
        --exclude-dir="^/proc" \
        --exclude-dir="^/dev" \
        "$MOUNT_DIR" 2>&1 | tee -a "$REPORT_FILE"
    
    INFECTED=$(grep "Infected files:" "$CLAM_LOG" | awk '{print $3}')
    
    if [ "$INFECTED" -gt 0 ]; then
        echo -e "${RED}[!] Found $INFECTED infected files!${NC}"
        echo "    See $CLAM_LOG for details"
    else
        echo -e "${GREEN}[+] No malware detected by ClamAV${NC}"
    fi

# ============================================================================
# PERSISTENCE DETECTION
# ============================================================================

scan_persistence() {
    echo -e "\n${BLUE}[*] Scanning for persistence mechanisms...${NC}"
    
    PERSIST_LOG="$LOG_DIR/persistence.log"
    echo "=== GhostWhisper Persistence Scan ===" > "$PERSIST_LOG"
    echo "Scan Time: $(date)" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
    echo "" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
    
    # Windows persistence locations
    if [ -d "$MOUNT_DIR/Windows" ]; then
        echo "[*] Detected Windows system, checking persistence..."
        
        # Startup folders
        echo "=== Startup Folders ===" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
        find "$MOUNT_DIR/Users" -path "*/Start Menu/Programs/Startup/*" -type f 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$PERSIST_LOG"
        find "$MOUNT_DIR/ProgramData/Microsoft/Windows/Start Menu/Programs/StartUp" -type f 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$PERSIST_LOG"
        
        # Scheduled tasks
        echo "=== Scheduled Tasks ===" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
        find "$MOUNT_DIR/Windows/System32/Tasks" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -50 | tee -a "$PERSIST_LOG"
        
        # Services (check registry hives later)
        echo "=== Suspicious executables in System32 ===" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
        find "$MOUNT_DIR/Windows/System32" -name "*.exe" -mtime -30 2>/dev/null | head -20 | tee -a "$PERSIST_LOG"
        
        # WMI persistence
        echo "=== WMI Repository ===" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
        ls -la "$MOUNT_DIR/Windows/System32/wbem/Repository" 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$PERSIST_LOG"
        
    fi
    
    # Linux persistence locations
    if [ -d "$MOUNT_DIR/etc" ]; then
        echo "[*] Detected Linux system, checking persistence..."
        
        echo "=== Cron Jobs ===" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
        cat "$MOUNT_DIR/etc/crontab" 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$PERSIST_LOG"
        ls -la "$MOUNT_DIR/etc/cron.d/" 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$PERSIST_LOG"
        find "$MOUNT_DIR/var/spool/cron" -type f 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$PERSIST_LOG"
        
        echo "=== Systemd Services ===" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
        find "$MOUNT_DIR/etc/systemd/system" -name "*.service" 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$PERSIST_LOG"
        
        echo "=== Init Scripts ===" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
        ls -la "$MOUNT_DIR/etc/init.d/" 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$PERSIST_LOG"
        
        echo "=== SSH Authorized Keys ===" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
        find "$MOUNT_DIR" -name "authorized_keys" 2>/dev/null | while read f; do
            echo "--- $f ---" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
            cat "$f" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
        done
        
        echo "=== Bashrc/Profile modifications ===" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
        find "$MOUNT_DIR" -name ".bashrc" -o -name ".profile" -o -name ".bash_profile" 2>/dev/null | while read f; do
            if grep -qE "(curl|wget|nc|bash -i|/dev/tcp)" "$f" 2>/dev/null; then
                echo "[!] Suspicious content in $f" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
                grep -E "(curl|wget|nc|bash -i|/dev/tcp)" "$f" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
            fi
        done
    fi
    
    echo -e "${GREEN}[+] Persistence scan complete - see $PERSIST_LOG${NC}"
}

# ============================================================================

analyze_bootloader() {
    echo -e "\n${BLUE}[*] Analyzing bootloader/MBR...${NC}"
    
    MBR_LOG="$LOG_DIR/mbr_analysis.log"
    
    # Get the disk device (not partition)
    DISK=$(echo "$TARGET_PARTITION" | sed 's/[0-9]*$//')
    
    echo "=== MBR Analysis for $DISK ===" > "$MBR_LOG"
    
    # Dump MBR
    dd if="$DISK" of="$LOG_DIR/mbr_backup.bin" bs=512 count=1 2>/dev/null
    echo "[+] MBR backed up to $LOG_DIR/mbr_backup.bin" >> "$MBR_LOG"
    
    # Hexdump for analysis
    xxd "$LOG_DIR/mbr_backup.bin" | head -32 >> "$MBR_LOG"
    
    # Check for known bootkit signatures
    if xxd "$LOG_DIR/mbr_backup.bin" | grep -qi "tdss\|alureon\|rovnix\|carberp"; then
        echo -e "${RED}[!] POTENTIAL BOOTKIT DETECTED!${NC}"
        echo "[!] BOOTKIT SIGNATURE DETECTED" >> "$MBR_LOG"
    else
        echo -e "${GREEN}[+] No known bootkit signatures found${NC}"
    fi
    
    # Check partition table
    echo "" >> "$MBR_LOG"
    echo "=== Partition Table ===" >> "$MBR_LOG"
    fdisk -l "$DISK" 2>/dev/null >> "$MBR_LOG"
}

# ============================================================================
# SECURE CLEANUP
# ============================================================================

run_cleanup() {
    echo -e "\n${BLUE}[*] Running secure cleanup...${NC}"
    
    CLEANUP_LOG="$LOG_DIR/cleanup.log"
    echo "=== GhostWhisper Cleanup Log ===" > "$CLEANUP_LOG"
    
    if [ -d "$MOUNT_DIR/Windows" ]; then
        # Windows cleanup
        echo "[*] Cleaning Windows temp files..."
        
        TEMP_DIRS=(
            "$MOUNT_DIR/Windows/Temp"
            "$MOUNT_DIR/Windows/Prefetch"
        )
        
        # User temp directories
        find "$MOUNT_DIR/Users" -type d -name "Temp" 2>/dev/null | while read d; do
            TEMP_DIRS+=("$d")
        done
        
        for dir in "${TEMP_DIRS[@]}"; do
            if [ -d "$dir" ]; then
                COUNT=$(find "$dir" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
                echo "[*] Cleaning $dir ($COUNT files)" | tee -a "$CLEANUP_LOG"
                find "$dir" -type f -delete 2>/dev/null || true
            fi
        done
        
        # Remove suspicious large files from temp
        echo "[*] Removing suspicious executables from temp locations..."
        find "$MOUNT_DIR/Users" -path "*/Temp/*" -name "*.exe" -size +100k -delete 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$CLEANUP_LOG"
        find "$MOUNT_DIR/Users" -path "*/Temp/*" -name "*.dll" -size +100k -delete 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$CLEANUP_LOG"
        
    elif [ -d "$MOUNT_DIR/etc" ]; then
        # Linux cleanup
        echo "[*] Cleaning Linux temp files..."
        
        find "$MOUNT_DIR/tmp" -type f -mtime +7 -delete 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$CLEANUP_LOG"
        find "$MOUNT_DIR/var/tmp" -type f -mtime +7 -delete 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$CLEANUP_LOG"
        
        # Clear old logs
        find "$MOUNT_DIR/var/log" -name "*.gz" -delete 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$CLEANUP_LOG"
        find "$MOUNT_DIR/var/log" -name "*.old" -delete 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$CLEANUP_LOG"
    fi
    
    echo -e "${GREEN}[+] Cleanup complete - see $CLEANUP_LOG${NC}"
}

# ============================================================================
# DATA RECOVERY MODE
# ============================================================================

run_rescue_mode() {
    echo -e "\n${BLUE}[*] Entering Rescue/Recovery Mode...${NC}"
    
    echo "Available recovery tools:"
    echo "  1) TestDisk  - Partition recovery"
    echo "  2) PhotoRec  - File recovery"
    echo "  3) ddrescue  - Disk imaging"
    echo "  4) Mount drives manually"
    echo "  5) Exit to shell"
    
    while true; do

        case "$choice" in
            1)
                if command -v testdisk >/dev/null 2>&1; then

                fi

                fi

                echo -n "Enter source device: "

                ;;

                echo -n "Enter partition to mount: "
                read part
                mount_target "$part" "false"

        esac
    done

main() {

function New-ISO-Oscdimg {

    Write-GhostLog "Creating ISO using oscdimg.exe..."
    
    $bootSector = "$SourceDir\boot\isolinux\isolinux.bin"
    
    $arguments = @(
        "-bootdata:2#p0,e,b`"$bootSector`"",
        "-u2",
        "-udfver102",
        "-lGHOST_CLEANER",
        "`"$SourceDir`"",
        "`"$IsoPath`""
    )
    
    $process = Start-Process -FilePath $OscdimgExe -ArgumentList $arguments -Wait -PassThru -NoNewWindow
    
    if ($process.ExitCode -eq 0) {

        Write-GhostLog "File already exists: $Destination" -Level "WARNING"
        return $true
    }
    
    try {
        Write-GhostLog "Downloading: $Url"
        $webClient = New-Object System.Net.WebClient
        $webClient.DownloadFile($Url, $Destination)
        Write-GhostLog "Downloaded: $Destination" -Level "SUCCESS"
        return $true
    }
    catch {
        Write-GhostLog "Failed to download: $Url - $_" -Level "ERROR"
        return $false
    }
}

# ============================================================================
# DRIVE DETECTION & MOUNTING
# ============================================================================

detect_drives() {
    echo -e "\n${BLUE}[*] Detecting available drives...${NC}"
    
    # List all block devices
    lsblk -o NAME,SIZE,TYPE,MOUNTPOINT,FSTYPE 2>/dev/null || fdisk -l 2>/dev/null
    
    echo ""
    echo -e "${YELLOW}Available partitions:${NC}"
    
    PARTITIONS=$(lsblk -lnp -o NAME,FSTYPE | grep -E 'ntfs|ext[234]|vfat|xfs|btrfs' | awk '{print $1}')
    
    if [ -z "$PARTITIONS" ]; then
        echo -e "${RED}[!] No mountable partitions found${NC}"
        return 1
    fi
    
    COUNT=1
    for part in $PARTITIONS; do
        FSTYPE=$(lsblk -no FSTYPE "$part" 2>/dev/null)
        SIZE=$(lsblk -no SIZE "$part" 2>/dev/null)
        echo "  [$COUNT] $part ($FSTYPE, $SIZE)"
        COUNT=$((COUNT + 1))
    done
    
    echo "$PARTITIONS" > /tmp/partitions.list
    return 0
}

mount_target() {
    local partition="$1"
    local readonly="$2"
    
    echo -e "${BLUE}[*] Mounting $partition to $MOUNT_DIR...${NC}"
    
    FSTYPE=$(lsblk -no FSTYPE "$partition" 2>/dev/null)
    
    MOUNT_OPTS=""
    if [ "$readonly" = "true" ]; then
        MOUNT_OPTS="-o ro"
    fi
    
    case "$FSTYPE" in
        ntfs|ntfs-3g)
            if [ "$readonly" = "true" ]; then
                ntfs-3g -o ro "$partition" "$MOUNT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || mount -t ntfs-3g -o ro "$partition" "$MOUNT_DIR"
            else
                ntfs-3g "$partition" "$MOUNT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || mount -t ntfs-3g "$partition" "$MOUNT_DIR"
            fi
            ;;
        *)
            mount $MOUNT_OPTS "$partition" "$MOUNT_DIR"
            ;;
    esac
    
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}[+] Successfully mounted $partition${NC}"
        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${RED}[!] Failed to mount $partition${NC}"
        return 1
    fi
}

        return 1

    fi
    
    CLAM_LOG="$LOG_DIR/clamav_scan.log"
    echo "[*] Scanning $MOUNT_DIR (this may take a while)..."
    
    clamscan -r --infected --log="$CLAM_LOG" \

        --exclude-dir="^/proc" \
        --exclude-dir="^/dev" \
        "$MOUNT_DIR" 2>&1 | tee -a "$REPORT_FILE"
    
    INFECTED=$(grep "Infected files:" "$CLAM_LOG" | awk '{print $3}')
    
    if [ "$INFECTED" -gt 0 ]; then

        echo "    See $CLAM_LOG for details"
    else
        echo -e "${GREEN}[+] No malware detected by ClamAV${NC}"
    fi

# ============================================================================
# PERSISTENCE DETECTION
# ============================================================================

scan_persistence() {
    echo -e "\n${BLUE}[*] Scanning for persistence mechanisms...${NC}"
    
    PERSIST_LOG="$LOG_DIR/persistence.log"
    echo "=== GhostWhisper Persistence Scan ===" > "$PERSIST_LOG"
    echo "Scan Time: $(date)" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
    echo "" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
    
    # Windows persistence locations
    if [ -d "$MOUNT_DIR/Windows" ]; then
        echo "[*] Detected Windows system, checking persistence..."
        
        # Startup folders
        echo "=== Startup Folders ===" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
        find "$MOUNT_DIR/Users" -path "*/Start Menu/Programs/Startup/*" -type f 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$PERSIST_LOG"
        find "$MOUNT_DIR/ProgramData/Microsoft/Windows/Start Menu/Programs/StartUp" -type f 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$PERSIST_LOG"
        
        # Scheduled tasks
        echo "=== Scheduled Tasks ===" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
        find "$MOUNT_DIR/Windows/System32/Tasks" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -50 | tee -a "$PERSIST_LOG"
        
        # Services (check registry hives later)
        echo "=== Suspicious executables in System32 ===" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
        find "$MOUNT_DIR/Windows/System32" -name "*.exe" -mtime -30 2>/dev/null | head -20 | tee -a "$PERSIST_LOG"
        
        # WMI persistence
        echo "=== WMI Repository ===" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
        ls -la "$MOUNT_DIR/Windows/System32/wbem/Repository" 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$PERSIST_LOG"
        
    fi
    
    # Linux persistence locations
    if [ -d "$MOUNT_DIR/etc" ]; then
        echo "[*] Detected Linux system, checking persistence..."
        
        echo "=== Cron Jobs ===" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
        cat "$MOUNT_DIR/etc/crontab" 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$PERSIST_LOG"
        ls -la "$MOUNT_DIR/etc/cron.d/" 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$PERSIST_LOG"
        find "$MOUNT_DIR/var/spool/cron" -type f 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$PERSIST_LOG"
        
        echo "=== Systemd Services ===" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
        find "$MOUNT_DIR/etc/systemd/system" -name "*.service" 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$PERSIST_LOG"
        
        echo "=== Init Scripts ===" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
        ls -la "$MOUNT_DIR/etc/init.d/" 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$PERSIST_LOG"
        
        echo "=== SSH Authorized Keys ===" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
        find "$MOUNT_DIR" -name "authorized_keys" 2>/dev/null | while read f; do
            echo "--- $f ---" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
            cat "$f" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
        done
        
        echo "=== Bashrc/Profile modifications ===" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
        find "$MOUNT_DIR" -name ".bashrc" -o -name ".profile" -o -name ".bash_profile" 2>/dev/null | while read f; do
            if grep -qE "(curl|wget|nc|bash -i|/dev/tcp)" "$f" 2>/dev/null; then
                echo "[!] Suspicious content in $f" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
                grep -E "(curl|wget|nc|bash -i|/dev/tcp)" "$f" >> "$PERSIST_LOG"
            fi
        done
    fi
    
    echo -e "${GREEN}[+] Persistence scan complete - see $PERSIST_LOG${NC}"
}

# ============================================================================
# MBR/BOOTLOADER ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================

analyze_bootloader() {
    echo -e "\n${BLUE}[*] Analyzing bootloader/MBR...${NC}"
    
    MBR_LOG="$LOG_DIR/mbr_analysis.log"
    
    # Get the disk device (not partition)
    DISK=$(echo "$TARGET_PARTITION" | sed 's/[0-9]*$//')
    
    echo "=== MBR Analysis for $DISK ===" > "$MBR_LOG"
    
    # Dump MBR
    dd if="$DISK" of="$LOG_DIR/mbr_backup.bin" bs=512 count=1 2>/dev/null
    echo "[+] MBR backed up to $LOG_DIR/mbr_backup.bin" >> "$MBR_LOG"
    
    # Hexdump for analysis
    xxd "$LOG_DIR/mbr_backup.bin" | head -32 >> "$MBR_LOG"
    
    # Check for known bootkit signatures
    if xxd "$LOG_DIR/mbr_backup.bin" | grep -qi "tdss\|alureon\|rovnix\|carberp"; then
        echo -e "${RED}[!] POTENTIAL BOOTKIT DETECTED!${NC}"
        echo "[!] BOOTKIT SIGNATURE DETECTED" >> "$MBR_LOG"
    else
        echo -e "${GREEN}[+] No known bootkit signatures found${NC}"
    fi
    
    # Check partition table
    echo "" >> "$MBR_LOG"
    echo "=== Partition Table ===" >> "$MBR_LOG"
    fdisk -l "$DISK" 2>/dev/null >> "$MBR_LOG"
}

# ============================================================================
# SECURE CLEANUP
# ============================================================================

run_cleanup() {
    echo -e "\n${BLUE}[*] Running secure cleanup...${NC}"
    
    CLEANUP_LOG="$LOG_DIR/cleanup.log"
    echo "=== GhostWhisper Cleanup Log ===" > "$CLEANUP_LOG"
    
    if [ -d "$MOUNT_DIR/Windows" ]; then
        # Windows cleanup
        echo "[*] Cleaning Windows temp files..."
        
        TEMP_DIRS=(
            "$MOUNT_DIR/Windows/Temp"
            "$MOUNT_DIR/Windows/Prefetch"
        )
        
        # User temp directories
        find "$MOUNT_DIR/Users" -type d -name "Temp" 2>/dev/null | while read d; do
            TEMP_DIRS+=("$d")
        done
        
        for dir in "${TEMP_DIRS[@]}"; do
            if [ -d "$dir" ]; then
                COUNT=$(find "$dir" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
                echo "[*] Cleaning $dir ($COUNT files)" | tee -a "$CLEANUP_LOG"
                find "$dir" -type f -delete 2>/dev/null || true
            fi
        done
        
        # Remove suspicious large files from temp
        echo "[*] Removing suspicious executables from temp locations..."
        find "$MOUNT_DIR/Users" -path "*/Temp/*" -name "*.exe" -size +100k -delete 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$CLEANUP_LOG"
        find "$MOUNT_DIR/Users" -path "*/Temp/*" -name "*.dll" -size +100k -delete 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$CLEANUP_LOG"
        
    elif [ -d "$MOUNT_DIR/etc" ]; then
        # Linux cleanup
        echo "[*] Cleaning Linux temp files..."
        
        find "$MOUNT_DIR/tmp" -type f -mtime +7 -delete 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$CLEANUP_LOG"
        find "$MOUNT_DIR/var/tmp" -type f -mtime +7 -delete 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$CLEANUP_LOG"
        
        # Clear old logs
        find "$MOUNT_DIR/var/log" -name "*.gz" -delete 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$CLEANUP_LOG"
        find "$MOUNT_DIR/var/log" -name "*.old" -delete 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$CLEANUP_LOG"
    fi
    
    echo -e "${GREEN}[+] Cleanup complete - see $CLEANUP_LOG${NC}"
}

# CreateGhostUSB.ps1
# GhostWhisper Bootable USB Creator
# Creates a bootable USB drive from ISO or direct file copy

param (
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string]$IsoPath = "",
    
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string]$DriveLetter = "",
    
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [ValidateSet("MBR", "GPT")]
    [string]$PartitionStyle = "MBR",
    
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [ValidateSet("FAT32", "NTFS", "exFAT")]
    [string]$FileSystem = "FAT32",
    
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string]$VolumeLabel = "GHOSTCLEAN",
    
    [switch]$DirectCopy,
    [switch]$Force,
    [switch]$SkipConfirmation
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$ScriptVersion = "2.0.0"

# ============================================================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================================

function Write-GhostLog {
    param([string]$Message, [string]$Level = "INFO")
    $timestamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"
    $color = switch ($Level) {
        "INFO"    { "Cyan" }
        "SUCCESS" { "Green" }
        "WARNING" { "Yellow" }
        "ERROR"   { "Red" }
        "DANGER"  { "Magenta" }
        default   { "White" }
    }
    Write-Host "[$timestamp] [$Level] $Message" -ForegroundColor $color
}

function Test-AdminPrivileges {
    $identity = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()
    $principal = New-Object Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal($identity)
    return $principal.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)
}

function Get-RemovableDrives {
    $drives = Get-WmiObject Win32_DiskDrive | Where-Object { 
        $_.MediaType -eq "Removable Media" -or $_.InterfaceType -eq "USB"
    }
    
    $driveInfo = @()
    
    foreach ($drive in $drives) {
        $partitions = Get-WmiObject -Query "ASSOCIATORS OF {Win32_DiskDrive.DeviceID='$($drive.DeviceID)'} WHERE AssocClass=Win32_DiskDriveToDiskPartition"
        
        foreach ($partition in $partitions) {
            $logicalDisks = Get-WmiObject -Query "ASSOCIATORS OF {Win32_DiskPartition.DeviceID='$($partition.DeviceID)'} WHERE AssocClass=Win32_LogicalDiskToPartition"
            
            foreach ($disk in $logicalDisks) {
                $driveInfo += [PSCustomObject]@{
                    DiskNumber   = $drive.Index
                    DeviceID     = $drive.DeviceID
                    DriveLetter  = $disk.DeviceID
                    Model        = $drive.Model
                    SizeGB       = [math]::Round($drive.Size / 1GB, 2)
                    MediaType    = $drive.MediaType
                    Interface    = $drive.InterfaceType
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    # Also get drives without partitions
    foreach ($drive in $drives) {
        $existing = $driveInfo | Where-Object { $_.DiskNumber -eq $drive.Index }
        if (-not $existing) {
            $driveInfo += [PSCustomObject]@{
                DiskNumber   = $drive.Index
                DeviceID     = $drive.DeviceID
                DriveLetter  = "N/A"
                Model        = $drive.Model
                SizeGB       = [math]::Round($drive.Size / 1GB, 2)
                MediaType    = $drive.MediaType
                Interface    = $drive.InterfaceType
            }
        }
    }
    
    return $driveInfo
}

function Show-Banner {
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "║       GhostWhisper Bootable USB Creator v$ScriptVersion           ║" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "║       Create bootable USB from ISO or source files        ║" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host ""
}

function Show-DriveSelection {
    Write-GhostLog "Detecting removable drives..."
    
    $drives = Get-RemovableDrives
    
    if ($drives.Count -eq 0) {
        Write-GhostLog "No removable USB drives detected!" -Level "ERROR"
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "Please ensure:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        Write-Host "  - USB drive is properly connected" -ForegroundColor White
        Write-Host "  - USB drive is recognized by Windows" -ForegroundColor White
        Write-Host "  - You have proper permissions" -ForegroundColor White
        return $null
    }
    
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host "║  ⚠️  WARNING: ALL DATA ON SELECTED DRIVE WILL BE PERMANENTLY DESTROYED!  ║" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host ""
    
    Write-Host "Available USB Drives:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────" -ForegroundColor Gray
    
    $index = 1
    foreach ($drive in $drives) {
        Write-Host "  [$index] " -NoNewline -ForegroundColor Green
        Write-Host "Disk $($drive.DiskNumber) " -NoNewline -ForegroundColor White
        Write-Host "($($drive.DriveLetter)) " -NoNewline -ForegroundColor Cyan
        Write-Host "- $($drive.Model) " -NoNewline -ForegroundColor White
        Write-Host "[$($drive.SizeGB) GB]" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        $index++
    }
    
    Write-Host "─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────" -ForegroundColor Gray
    Write-Host "  [0] Cancel" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host ""
    
    do {
        $selection = Read-Host "Select drive number"
        $selectionInt = 0
        $valid = [int]::TryParse($selection, [ref]$selectionInt)
    } while (-not $valid -or $selectionInt -lt 0 -or $selectionInt -gt $drives.Count)
    
    if ($selectionInt -eq 0) {
        Write-GhostLog "Operation cancelled by user" -Level "WARNING"
        return $null
    }
    
    return $drives[$selectionInt - 1]
}

function Confirm-Operation {
    param(
        [PSCustomObject]$Drive
    )
    
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "  FINAL CONFIRMATION" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "  Target: " -NoNewline -ForegroundColor White
    Write-Host "Disk $($Drive.DiskNumber) - $($Drive.Model)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host "  Size:   " -NoNewline -ForegroundColor White
    Write-Host "$($Drive.SizeGB) GB" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host "  Drive:  " -NoNewline -ForegroundColor White
    Write-Host "$($Drive.DriveLetter)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "  ⚠️  ALL DATA WILL BE PERMANENTLY ERASED!" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host ""
    
    $confirm = Read-Host "Type 'GHOST' to confirm and proceed"
    
    return $confirm -eq "GHOST"
}

# ============================================================================
# USB FORMATTING FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================================

function Format-USBDrive {
    param(
        [int]$DiskNumber,
        [string]$PartStyle,
        [string]$FSType,
        [string]$Label
    )
    
    Write-GhostLog "Preparing USB drive (Disk $DiskNumber)..."
    
    # Clean the disk
    Write-GhostLog "Cleaning disk..."
    
    $diskpartScript = @"
select disk $DiskNumber
clean
"@
    
    $diskpartScript | diskpart | Out-Null
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    
    # Initialize disk
    Write-GhostLog "Initializing disk with $PartStyle partition style..."
    
    try {
        Initialize-Disk -Number $DiskNumber -PartitionStyle $PartStyle -ErrorAction Stop
    }
    catch {
        Write-GhostLog "Disk already initialized or error: $_" -Level "WARNING"
    }
    
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
    
    # Create partition
    Write-GhostLog "Creating partition..."
    
    $partition = New-Partition -DiskNumber $DiskNumber -UseMaximumSize -IsActive -AssignDriveLetter
    $newDriveLetter = $partition.DriveLetter
    
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    
    # Format partition
    Write-GhostLog "Formatting with $FSType..."
    
    Format-Volume -DriveLetter $newDriveLetter -FileSystem $FSType -NewFileSystemLabel $Label -Force -Confirm:$false | Out-Null
    
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    
    Write-GhostLog "Drive formatted successfully as ${newDriveLetter}:" -Level "SUCCESS"
    
    return $newDriveLetter
}

# ============================================================================
# BOOTLOADER INSTALLATION
# ============================================================================

function Install-Syslinux {
    param(
        [string]$DriveLetter
    )
    
    Write-GhostLog "Installing SYSLINUX bootloader..."
    
    $syslinuxPath = "$PSScriptRoot\Tools\syslinux.exe"
    $syslinuxDir = "${DriveLetter}:\syslinux"
    $bootDir = "${DriveLetter}:\boot\syslinux"
    
    # Create directories
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $syslinuxDir -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $bootDir -Force | Out-Null
    
    # Check if syslinux.exe exists
    if (Test-Path $syslinuxPath) {
        Write-GhostLog "Running syslinux installer..."
        
        # Install MBR and boot sector
        $arguments = @("-m", "-a", "-d", "/syslinux", "${DriveLetter}:")
        Start-Process -FilePath $syslinuxPath -ArgumentList $arguments -Wait -NoNewWindow
        
        Write-GhostLog "SYSLINUX installed" -Level "SUCCESS"
        return $true
    }
    else {
        Write-GhostLog "syslinux.exe not found at $syslinuxPath" -Level "WARNING"
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "To complete bootable USB creation:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        Write-Host "  1. Download SYSLINUX from: https://www.syslinux.org/" -ForegroundColor White
        Write-Host "  2. Extract and copy syslinux.exe to: $PSScriptRoot\Tools\" -ForegroundColor White
        Write-Host "  3. Run this script again" -ForegroundColor White
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "Alternative: Use Rufus (https://rufus.ie) to create bootable USB from ISO" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        return $false
    }
}

function Install-BootloaderConfig {
    param(
        [string]$DriveLetter
    )
    
    Write-GhostLog "Creating bootloader configuration..."
    
    # Create syslinux.cfg
    $syslinuxCfg = @"
# GhostWhisper Cleaner - SYSLINUX Configuration

DEFAULT vesamenu.c32
PROMPT 0
TIMEOUT 300
ONTIMEOUT ghostcleaner

MENU TITLE GhostWhisper Cleaner OS v2.0
MENU BACKGROUND #000000
MENU COLOR border       30;44   #40ffffff #00000000 std
MENU COLOR title        1;36;44 #ff00ffff #00000000 std
MENU COLOR sel          7;37;40 #e0ffffff #20ffffff all
MENU COLOR unsel        37;44   #90ffffff #00000000 std

LABEL ghostcleaner
    MENU LABEL ^GhostWhisper Cleaner (Full Scan Mode)
    MENU DEFAULT
    KERNEL /boot/vmlinuz64
    APPEND initrd=/boot/corepure64.gz quiet loglevel=3 ghost_mode=full
    TEXT HELP
    Full system scan with malware detection and cleanup.
    ENDTEXT

LABEL quickscan
    MENU LABEL ^Quick Scan (Fast Analysis)
    KERNEL /boot/vmlinuz64
    APPEND initrd=/boot/corepure64.gz quiet loglevel=3 ghost_mode=quick

LABEL rescue
    MENU LABEL ^Rescue Mode (Data Recovery)
    KERNEL /boot/vmlinuz64
    APPEND initrd=/boot/corepure64.gz quiet loglevel=3 ghost_mode=rescue

LABEL forensic
    MENU LABEL ^Forensic Mode (Read-Only)
    KERNEL /boot/vmlinuz64
    APPEND initrd=/boot/corepure64.gz quiet loglevel=3 ghost_mode=forensic

LABEL shell
    MENU LABEL ^Shell Access (Expert Mode)
    KERNEL /boot/vmlinuz64
    APPEND initrd=/boot/corepure64.gz quiet loglevel=3 ghost_mode=shell

LABEL reboot
    MENU LABEL ^Reboot System
    COM32 reboot.c32

LABEL poweroff
    MENU LABEL ^Power Off
    COM32 poweroff.c32
"@
    
    $configPaths = @(
        "${DriveLetter}:\syslinux\syslinux.cfg",
        "${DriveLetter}:\boot\syslinux\syslinux.cfg"
    )
    
    foreach ($path in $configPaths) {
        $dir = Split-Path -Parent $path
        if (-not (Test-Path $dir)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null
        }
        Set-Content -Path $path -Value $syslinuxCfg -Encoding ASCII
    }
    
    Write-GhostLog "Bootloader configuration created" -Level "SUCCESS"
}

# ============================================================================
# COPY FILES TO USB
# ============================================================================

function Copy-ISOToUSB {
    param(
        [string]$IsoFile,
        [string]$DriveLetter
    )
    
    Write-GhostLog "Extracting ISO to USB drive..."
    
    # Mount the ISO
    $mountResult = Mount-DiskImage -ImagePath $IsoFile -PassThru
    $isoDrive = ($mountResult | Get-Volume).DriveLetter
    
    if (-not $isoDrive) {
        Write-GhostLog "Failed to mount ISO" -Level "ERROR"
        return $false
    }
    
    Write-GhostLog "ISO mounted as ${isoDrive}:"
    
    try {
        # Copy all files
        Write-GhostLog "Copying files (this may take a while)..."
        
        $source = "${isoDrive}:\"
        $destination = "${DriveLetter}:\"
        
        Copy-Item -Path "$source*" -Destination $destination -Recurse -Force
        
        Write-GhostLog "Files copied successfully" -Level "SUCCESS"
        return $true
    }
    catch {
        Write-GhostLog "Error copying files: $_" -Level "ERROR"
        return $false
    }
    finally {
        # Unmount ISO
        Dismount-DiskImage -ImagePath $IsoFile | Out-Null
        Write-GhostLog "ISO unmounted"
    }
}

function Copy-SourceFilesToUSB {
    param(
        [string]$DriveLetter
    )
    
    Write-GhostLog "Copying GhostWhisper source files to USB..."
    
    $sourceDir = "$PSScriptRoot\GhostCleanerISO"
    
    if (-not (Test-Path $sourceDir)) {
        $sourceDir = "$PSScriptRoot\GhostISO"
    }
    
    if (-not (Test-Path $sourceDir)) {
        Write-GhostLog "Source directory not found. Run CreateGhostCleanerISO.ps1 first." -Level "ERROR"
        return $false
    }
    
    $destination = "${DriveLetter}:\"
    
    # Create required directories
    $directories = @(
        "${DriveLetter}:\boot",
        "${DriveLetter}:\boot\syslinux",
        "${DriveLetter}:\ghost",
        "${DriveLetter}:\ghost\scripts",
        "${DriveLetter}:\ghost\tools",
        "${DriveLetter}:\ghost\logs"
    )
    
    foreach ($dir in $directories) {
        if (-not (Test-Path $dir)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null
        }
    }
    
    # Copy source files
    if (Test-Path $sourceDir) {
        Copy-Item -Path "$sourceDir\*" -Destination $destination -Recurse -Force
    }
    
    # Copy ghost scripts from Modules
    $modulesDir = (Get-Item $PSScriptRoot).Parent.Parent.FullName + "\Modules"
    if (Test-Path $modulesDir) {
        $scriptsToInclude = @(
            "ExorcistMode.ps1",
            "LinuxPDF_Runtime.ps1",
            "AnomalyHunter.ps1"
        )
        
        foreach ($script in $scriptsToInclude) {
            $scriptPath = Join-Path $modulesDir $script
            if (Test-Path $scriptPath) {
                Copy-Item -Path $scriptPath -Destination "${DriveLetter}:\ghost\scripts\" -Force
            }
        }
    }
    
    Write-GhostLog "Source files copied successfully" -Level "SUCCESS"
    return $true
}

# ============================================================================
# VERIFICATION
# ============================================================================

function Test-BootableUSB {
    param(
        [string]$DriveLetter
    )
    
    Write-GhostLog "Verifying bootable USB..."
    
    $requiredFiles = @(
        "${DriveLetter}:\boot\vmlinuz64",
        "${DriveLetter}:\boot\corepure64.gz"
    )
    
    $optionalFiles = @(
        "${DriveLetter}:\syslinux\syslinux.cfg",
        "${DriveLetter}:\ghost\scripts\ghost_cleaner.sh"
    )
    
    $missingRequired = @()
    $missingOptional = @()
    
    foreach ($file in $requiredFiles) {
        if (-not (Test-Path $file)) {
            $missingRequired += $file
        }
    }
    
    foreach ($file in $optionalFiles) {
        if (-not (Test-Path $file)) {
            $missingOptional += $file
        }
    }
    
    if ($missingRequired.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-GhostLog "Missing required files:" -Level "WARNING"
        foreach ($file in $missingRequired) {
            Write-Host "    - $file" -ForegroundColor Red
        }
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "Download TinyCore Linux files from:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        Write-Host "  http://tinycorelinux.net/14.x/x86_64/release/" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        Write-Host ""
        return $false
    }
    
    if ($missingOptional.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-GhostLog "Missing optional files (USB may still work):" -Level "WARNING"
        foreach ($file in $missingOptional) {
            Write-Host "    - $file" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        }
    }
    
    Write-GhostLog "USB verification passed" -Level "SUCCESS"
    return $true
}

# ============================================================================
# MAIN EXECUTION
# ============================================================================

function Main {
    Show-Banner
    
    # Check admin privileges
    if (-not (Test-AdminPrivileges)) {
        Write-GhostLog "This script requires Administrator privileges!" -Level "ERROR"
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "Please run PowerShell as Administrator and try again." -ForegroundColor Yellow
        exit 1
    }
    
    # Select drive
    $selectedDrive = $null
    
    if ($DriveLetter) {
        # Use specified drive letter
        $drives = Get-RemovableDrives
        $selectedDrive = $drives | Where-Object { $_.DriveLetter -eq "${DriveLetter}:" -or $_.DriveLetter -eq $DriveLetter }
        
        if (-not $selectedDrive) {
            Write-GhostLog "Specified drive $DriveLetter not found or not removable" -Level "ERROR"
            exit 1
        }
    }
    else {
        # Interactive selection
        $selectedDrive = Show-DriveSelection
        
        if (-not $selectedDrive) {
            exit 0
        }
    }
    
    # Confirm operation
    if (-not $SkipConfirmation) {
        if (-not (Confirm-Operation -Drive $selectedDrive)) {
            Write-GhostLog "Operation cancelled" -Level "WARNING"
            exit 0
        }
    }
    
    Write-Host ""
    Write-GhostLog "Starting USB creation process..."
    Write-Host ""
    
    # Format the drive
    $newDriveLetter = Format-USBDrive -DiskNumber $selectedDrive.DiskNumber `
                                       -PartStyle $PartitionStyle `
                                       -FSType $FileSystem `
                                       -Label $VolumeLabel
    
    # Install bootloader
    $bootloaderInstalled = Install-Syslinux -DriveLetter $newDriveLetter
    Install-BootloaderConfig -DriveLetter $newDriveLetter
    
    # Copy files
    if ($IsoPath -and (Test-Path $IsoPath)) {
        Copy-ISOToUSB -IsoFile $IsoPath -DriveLetter $newDriveLetter
    }
    else {
        Copy-SourceFilesToUSB -DriveLetter $newDriveLetter
    }
    
    # Verify
    $verified = Test-BootableUSB -DriveLetter $newDriveLetter
    
    # Summary
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "  USB CREATION SUMMARY" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "  Drive:      ${newDriveLetter}:" -ForegroundColor White
    Write-Host "  Label:      $VolumeLabel" -ForegroundColor White
    Write-Host "  FileSystem: $FileSystem" -ForegroundColor White
    Write-Host "  Bootloader: $(if($bootloaderInstalled){'Installed'}else{'Manual setup required'})" -ForegroundColor $(if($bootloaderInstalled){'Green'}else{'Yellow'})
    Write-Host "  Verified:   $(if($verified){'PASS'}else{'INCOMPLETE'})" -ForegroundColor $(if($verified){'Green'}else{'Yellow'})
    Write-Host ""
    
    if (-not $bootloaderInstalled) {
        Write-Host "  ℹ️  To complete bootable setup, use Rufus or similar tool" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        Write-Host "     to write the ISO to USB, or manually install SYSLINUX." -ForegroundColor Yellow
        Write-Host ""
    }
    
    if ($verified) {
        Write-Host "  ✅ USB drive is ready! Boot from it to run GhostWhisper Cleaner." -ForegroundColor Green
    }
    else {
        Write-Host "  ⚠️  USB may need additional files. Check messages above." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    }
    
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host ""
    
    Write-GhostLog "USB creation process complete" -Level "SUCCESS"
}

# Run main function
Main

function Write-GhostLog {
    param([string]$Message, [string]$Level = "INFO")
    $timestamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"
    $color = switch ($Level) {
        "INFO"    { "Cyan" }
        "SUCCESS" { "Green" }
        "WARNING" { "Yellow" }
        "ERROR"   { "Red" }
        "DANGER"  { "Magenta" }
        default   { "White" }
    }
    Write-Host "[$timestamp] [$Level] $Message" -ForegroundColor $color
}

function Test-AdminPrivileges {
    $identity = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()
    $principal = New-Object Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal($identity)
    return $principal.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)
}

function Get-RemovableDrives {
    $drives = Get-WmiObject Win32_DiskDrive | Where-Object { 
        $_.MediaType -eq "Removable Media" -or $_.InterfaceType -eq "USB"
    }
    
    $driveInfo = @()
    
    foreach ($drive in $drives) {
        $partitions = Get-WmiObject -Query "ASSOCIATORS OF {Win32_DiskDrive.DeviceID='$($drive.DeviceID)'} WHERE AssocClass=Win32_DiskDriveToDiskPartition"
        
        foreach ($partition in $partitions) {
            $logicalDisks = Get-WmiObject -Query "ASSOCIATORS OF {Win32_DiskPartition.DeviceID='$($partition.DeviceID)'} WHERE AssocClass=Win32_LogicalDiskToPartition"
            
            foreach ($disk in $logicalDisks) {
                $driveInfo += [PSCustomObject]@{
                    DiskNumber   = $drive.Index
                    DeviceID     = $drive.DeviceID
                    DriveLetter  = $disk.DeviceID
                    Model        = $drive.Model
                    SizeGB       = [math]::Round($drive.Size / 1GB, 2)
                    MediaType    = $drive.MediaType
                    Interface    = $drive.InterfaceType
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    # Also get drives without partitions
    foreach ($drive in $drives) {
        $existing = $driveInfo | Where-Object { $_.DiskNumber -eq $drive.Index }
        if (-not $existing) {
            $driveInfo += [PSCustomObject]@{
                DiskNumber   = $drive.Index
                DeviceID     = $drive.DeviceID
                DriveLetter  = "N/A"
                Model        = $drive.Model
                SizeGB       = [math]::Round($drive.Size / 1GB, 2)
                MediaType    = $drive.MediaType
                Interface    = $drive.InterfaceType
            }
        }
    }
    
    return $driveInfo
}

    Write-Host ""

    Write-Host "║  ⚠️  WARNING: ALL DATA ON SELECTED DRIVE WILL BE PERMANENTLY DESTROYED!  ║" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host ""

# ============================================================================

function Format-USBDrive {
    param(
        [int]$DiskNumber,
        [string]$PartStyle,
        [string]$FSType,
        [string]$Label
    )
    
    Write-GhostLog "Preparing USB drive (Disk $DiskNumber)..."
    
    # Clean the disk
    Write-GhostLog "Cleaning disk..."
    
    $diskpartScript = @"
select disk $DiskNumber
clean
"@
    
    $diskpartScript | diskpart | Out-Null
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    
    # Initialize disk
    Write-GhostLog "Initializing disk with $PartStyle partition style..."
    
    try {
        Initialize-Disk -Number $DiskNumber -PartitionStyle $PartStyle -ErrorAction Stop
    }
    catch {
        Write-GhostLog "Disk already initialized or error: $_" -Level "WARNING"
    }
    
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
    
    # Create partition
    Write-GhostLog "Creating partition..."
    
    $partition = New-Partition -DiskNumber $DiskNumber -UseMaximumSize -IsActive -AssignDriveLetter
    $newDriveLetter = $partition.DriveLetter
    
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    
    # Format partition
    Write-GhostLog "Formatting with $FSType..."
    
    Format-Volume -DriveLetter $newDriveLetter -FileSystem $FSType -NewFileSystemLabel $Label -Force -Confirm:$false | Out-Null
    
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    
    Write-GhostLog "Drive formatted successfully as ${newDriveLetter}:" -Level "SUCCESS"
    
    return $newDriveLetter
}

# ============================================================================
# BOOTLOADER INSTALLATION

function Install-Syslinux {
    param(
        [string]$DriveLetter
    )
    
    Write-GhostLog "Installing SYSLINUX bootloader..."
    
    $syslinuxPath = "$PSScriptRoot\Tools\syslinux.exe"
    $syslinuxDir = "${DriveLetter}:\syslinux"
    $bootDir = "${DriveLetter}:\boot\syslinux"
    
    # Create directories
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $syslinuxDir -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $bootDir -Force | Out-Null
    
    # Check if syslinux.exe exists
    if (Test-Path $syslinuxPath) {
        Write-GhostLog "Running syslinux installer..."
        
        # Install MBR and boot sector
        $arguments = @("-m", "-a", "-d", "/syslinux", "${DriveLetter}:")
        Start-Process -FilePath $syslinuxPath -ArgumentList $arguments -Wait -NoNewWindow
        
        Write-GhostLog "SYSLINUX installed" -Level "SUCCESS"
        return $true
    }
    else {
        Write-GhostLog "syslinux.exe not found at $syslinuxPath" -Level "WARNING"
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "To complete bootable USB creation:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        Write-Host "  1. Download SYSLINUX from: https://www.syslinux.org/" -ForegroundColor White
        Write-Host "  2. Extract and copy syslinux.exe to: $PSScriptRoot\Tools\" -ForegroundColor White
        Write-Host "  3. Run this script again" -ForegroundColor White
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "Alternative: Use Rufus (https://rufus.ie) to create bootable USB from ISO" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        return $false
    }
}

function Install-BootloaderConfig {
    param(

    $syslinuxCfg = @"

    foreach ($path in $configPaths) {

# ============================================================================
# COPY FILES TO USB
# ============================================================================

function Copy-ISOToUSB {
    param(
        [string]$IsoFile,
        [string]$DriveLetter
    )
    
    Write-GhostLog "Extracting ISO to USB drive..."
    
    # Mount the ISO
    $mountResult = Mount-DiskImage -ImagePath $IsoFile -PassThru
    $isoDrive = ($mountResult | Get-Volume).DriveLetter
    
    if (-not $isoDrive) {
        Write-GhostLog "Failed to mount ISO" -Level "ERROR"
        return $false
    }
    
    Write-GhostLog "ISO mounted as ${isoDrive}:"
    
    try {
        # Copy all files
        Write-GhostLog "Copying files (this may take a while)..."
        
        $source = "${isoDrive}:\"
        $destination = "${DriveLetter}:\"
        
        Copy-Item -Path "$source*" -Destination $destination -Recurse -Force
        
        Write-GhostLog "Files copied successfully" -Level "SUCCESS"
        return $true
    }
    catch {
        Write-GhostLog "Error copying files: $_" -Level "ERROR"
        return $false
    }
    finally {
        # Unmount ISO
        Dismount-DiskImage -ImagePath $IsoFile | Out-Null
        Write-GhostLog "ISO unmounted"
    }
}

function Copy-SourceFilesToUSB {
    param(
        [string]$DriveLetter
    )
    
    Write-GhostLog "Copying GhostWhisper source files to USB..."
    
    $sourceDir = "$PSScriptRoot\GhostCleanerISO"
    
    if (-not (Test-Path $sourceDir)) {
        $sourceDir = "$PSScriptRoot\GhostISO"
    }
    
    if (-not (Test-Path $sourceDir)) {
        Write-GhostLog "Source directory not found. Run CreateGhostCleanerISO.ps1 first." -Level "ERROR"
        return $false
    }
    
    $destination = "${DriveLetter}:\"
    
    # Create required directories
    $directories = @(
        "${DriveLetter}:\boot",
        "${DriveLetter}:\boot\syslinux",
        "${DriveLetter}:\ghost",
        "${DriveLetter}:\ghost\scripts",
        "${DriveLetter}:\ghost\tools",
        "${DriveLetter}:\ghost\logs"
    )
    
    foreach ($dir in $directories) {
        if (-not (Test-Path $dir)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null
        }
    }
    
    # Copy source files
    if (Test-Path $sourceDir) {
        Copy-Item -Path "$sourceDir\*" -Destination $destination -Recurse -Force
    }
    
    # Copy ghost scripts from Modules
    $modulesDir = (Get-Item $PSScriptRoot).Parent.Parent.FullName + "\Modules"
    if (Test-Path $modulesDir) {
        $scriptsToInclude = @(
            "ExorcistMode.ps1",
            "LinuxPDF_Runtime.ps1",
            "AnomalyHunter.ps1"
        )
        
        foreach ($script in $scriptsToInclude) {
            $scriptPath = Join-Path $modulesDir $script
            if (Test-Path $scriptPath) {
                Copy-Item -Path $scriptPath -Destination "${DriveLetter}:\ghost\scripts\" -Force
            }
        }
    }
    
    Write-GhostLog "Source files copied successfully" -Level "SUCCESS"
    return $true
}

# ============================================================================
# VERIFICATION
# ============================================================================

function Test-BootableUSB {
    param(
        [string]$DriveLetter
    )
    
    Write-GhostLog "Verifying bootable USB..."
    
    $requiredFiles = @(
        "${DriveLetter}:\boot\vmlinuz64",
        "${DriveLetter}:\boot\corepure64.gz"
    )
    
    $optionalFiles = @(
        "${DriveLetter}:\syslinux\syslinux.cfg",
        "${DriveLetter}:\ghost\scripts\ghost_cleaner.sh"
    )
    
    $missingRequired = @()
    $missingOptional = @()
    
    foreach ($file in $requiredFiles) {
        if (-not (Test-Path $file)) {
            $missingRequired += $file
        }
    }
    
    foreach ($file in $optionalFiles) {
        if (-not (Test-Path $file)) {
            $missingOptional += $file
        }
    }
    
    if ($missingRequired.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-GhostLog "Missing required files:" -Level "WARNING"
        foreach ($file in $missingRequired) {
            Write-Host "    - $file" -ForegroundColor Red
        }
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "Download TinyCore Linux files from:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        Write-Host "  http://tinycorelinux.net/14.x/x86_64/release/" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        Write-Host ""
        return $false
    }
    
    if ($missingOptional.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-GhostLog "Missing optional files (USB may still work):" -Level "WARNING"
        foreach ($file in $missingOptional) {
            Write-Host "    - $file" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        }
    }
    
    Write-GhostLog "USB verification passed" -Level "SUCCESS"
    return $true
}

# ============================================================================
# MAIN EXECUTION
# ============================================================================

function Main {
    Show-Banner
    
    # Check admin privileges
    if (-not (Test-AdminPrivileges)) {
        Write-GhostLog "This script requires Administrator privileges!" -Level "ERROR"
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "Please run PowerShell as Administrator and try again." -ForegroundColor Yellow
        exit 1
    }
    
    # Select drive
    $selectedDrive = $null
    
    if ($DriveLetter) {
        # Use specified drive letter
        $drives = Get-RemovableDrives
        $selectedDrive = $drives | Where-Object { $_.DriveLetter -eq "${DriveLetter}:" -or $_.DriveLetter -eq $DriveLetter }
        
        if (-not $selectedDrive) {
            Write-GhostLog "Specified drive $DriveLetter not found or not removable" -Level "ERROR"
            exit 1
        }
    }
    else {
        # Interactive selection
        $selectedDrive = Show-DriveSelection
        
        if (-not $selectedDrive) {
            exit 0
        }
    }
    
    # Confirm operation
    if (-not $SkipConfirmation) {
        if (-not (Confirm-Operation -Drive $selectedDrive)) {
            Write-GhostLog "Operation cancelled" -Level "WARNING"
            exit 0
        }
    }
    
    Write-Host ""
    Write-GhostLog "Starting USB creation process..."
    Write-Host ""
    
    # Format the drive
    $newDriveLetter = Format-USBDrive -DiskNumber $selectedDrive.DiskNumber `
                                       -PartStyle $PartitionStyle `
                                       -FSType $FileSystem `
                                       -Label $VolumeLabel
    
    # Install bootloader
    $bootloaderInstalled = Install-Syslinux -DriveLetter $newDriveLetter
    Install-BootloaderConfig -DriveLetter $newDriveLetter
    
    # Copy files
    if ($IsoPath -and (Test-Path $IsoPath)) {
        Copy-ISOToUSB -IsoFile $IsoPath -DriveLetter $newDriveLetter
    }
    else {
        Copy-SourceFilesToUSB -DriveLetter $newDriveLetter
    }
    
    # Verify
    $verified = Test-BootableUSB -DriveLetter $newDriveLetter
    
    # Summary
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "  USB CREATION SUMMARY" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "  Drive:      ${newDriveLetter}:" -ForegroundColor White
    Write-Host "  Label:      $VolumeLabel" -ForegroundColor White
    Write-Host "  FileSystem: $FileSystem" -ForegroundColor White
    Write-Host "  Bootloader: $(if($bootloaderInstalled){'Installed'}else{'Manual setup required'})" -ForegroundColor $(if($bootloaderInstalled){'Green'}else{'Yellow'})
    Write-Host "  Verified:   $(if($verified){'PASS'}else{'INCOMPLETE'})" -ForegroundColor $(if($verified){'Green'}else{'Yellow'})
    Write-Host ""
    
    if (-not $bootloaderInstalled) {
        Write-Host "  ℹ️  To complete bootable setup, use Rufus or similar tool" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        Write-Host "     to write the ISO to USB, or manually install SYSLINUX." -ForegroundColor Yellow
        Write-Host ""
    }
    
    if ($verified) {
        Write-Host "  ✅ USB drive is ready! Boot from it to run GhostWhisper Cleaner." -ForegroundColor Green
    }
    else {
        Write-Host "  ⚠️  USB may need additional files. Check messages above." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    }
    
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host ""
    
    Write-GhostLog "USB creation process complete" -Level "SUCCESS"
}

Main
